ratingSchedule.note: Schedule of ratings, cardiovascular system; diagnostic code 7007 covers hypertensive heart disease under the diseases-of-the-heart rating framework.
Schedule of ratings, cardiovascular system; diagnostic code 7020 covers cardiomyopathy under the diseases-of-the-heart rating framework.

Schedule of ratings, cardiovascular system; diagnostic code 7016 covers heart valve replacement (prosthesis), including post-replacement evaluation under the General Rating Formula for Diseases of the Heart after the prescribed post-hospitalization period.
Schedule of ratings, cardiovascular system; diagnostic code 7017 covers coronary bypass surgery and directs subsequent evaluation under the General Rating Formula for Diseases of the Heart.

Schedule of ratings, cardiovascular system; diagnostic code 7019 covers cardiac transplantation and directs later evaluation under the General Rating Formula for Diseases of the Heart after the prescribed transplant period.

Schedule of ratings, cardiovascular system; diagnostic code 7018 covers implantable cardiac pacemakers and directs later evaluation according to the underlying rhythm or conduction disorder, with a stated minimum evaluation.

Schedule of ratings, cardiovascular system; diagnostic code 7115 covers thrombo-angiitis obliterans (Buerger's Disease), with lower-extremity disease rated under diagnostic code 7114 and separate upper-extremity criteria.

conditions.name: Pulmonary Hypertension

ratingSchedule.note: Although retained in the Wave 3 cardiovascular product grouping, pulmonary hypertension is evaluated in the respiratory schedule: diagnostic code 6817 covers pulmonary vascular disease, including primary pulmonary hypertension and specified secondary pulmonary-hypertension presentations.

reviewNotes: Regulatory rating authority is the respiratory schedule under 38 CFR 4.97 / diagnostic code 6817, not the cardiovascular schedule under 38 CFR 4.104.
